text:
The doctor was pleasant and polite, and the staff at the counter was also polite.
However, I'd like to criticize the staff in the dispensing room. Today, my girlfriend had a stomach ache and went to the clinic. The doctor spoke very well, but the staff in the dispensing room asked my girlfriend if she came to get a medical certificate. They said she lied about her stomach ache and spoke rudely to her. After receiving the medicine, they didn't tell me anything about the dosage. I understand that there are instructions to read, but it would be good if they could have reiterated it.
The service staff were very rude (at the pharmacy). Please improve this; I wasn't using the service for free.
